comment: Enters the startup tutorial as a Wizard, spends ten turns there, then answers #quit's tutorial query with y. end.c done2() schedules the return; do.c goto_level() calls nhlua.c tutorial(FALSE), and nhlib.lua tutorial_leave() restores the saved turn counter, inventory, worn items, and spellbook through nhl_gamestate(TRUE). The inventory and spell listings show the restored state.
